paragraph: New Milford is a single-family town, and the numbers are unambiguous: 47 sales over six months at a median of $715,000, a sale-to-list ratio of 1.025, 62 percent of homes going above asking, and a median of 17 days on market. That is a real seller's market with plenty of multiple offer situations. The typical sale is a three-bedroom cape or colonial with two full baths, which is what holds the median where it is. Prices ran from $365,000 to $1,675,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. Monthly counts are thin until July, when 18 closings landed at a median of $750,500, right where you would expect the summer closing peak. If New Milford follows the usual arc, volume tapers modestly into fall. Expect competition on the good ones.
